title: 【RPG Design Guides】Estimating Development Scale and Duration

blocks.source: 【RPG制作講座】開発規模・期間の想定
blocks.translation: 【RPG Design Guides】Estimating Development Scale and Duration

blocks.source: 開発環境を決めたのならば『どの程度の規模』の作品を『どの程度の期間』で作成するのかも考えてみよう。参考に有名市販ＲＰＧのデータを挙げてみた。
blocks.translation: Once you have decided on your development environment, consider what scale of project you want to create and how long it will take. For reference, I have listed data for several well-known commercial RPGs.

blocks.source: 作品
blocks.translation: Title

blocks.source: 町数
blocks.translation: Number of towns

blocks.source: ダンジョン数
blocks.translation: Number of dungeons

blocks.source: 仲間数
blocks.translation: Number of party members

blocks.source: 職業数
blocks.translation: Number of classes

blocks.source: 文字数
blocks.translation: Character count

blocks.source: 作品
blocks.translation: Title

blocks.source: 町数
blocks.translation: Number of towns

blocks.source: ダンジョン数
blocks.translation: Number of dungeons

blocks.source: 仲間数
blocks.translation: Number of party members

blocks.source: 職業数
blocks.translation: Number of classes

blocks.source: 文字数
blocks.translation: Character count

blocks.source: ※数値は解釈の違いによって多少前後する。
blocks.translation: ※The figures may vary slightly depending on how they are interpreted.

blocks.source: 例：ＤＱ３の岬の洞窟とナジミの塔は１ダンジョンとしてカウント。
blocks.translation: Example: The Cape Cave and Najimi Tower in DQ3 are counted as one dungeon.

blocks.source: ※リメイクではなくオリジナル版を基準としている。
blocks.translation: ※The original versions, not the remakes, are used as the basis.

blocks.source: ※仲間数は最後まで連れていけることが条件。
blocks.translation: ※A party member is counted only if they can be taken along until the end.

blocks.source: ※文字数はストーリー上のセリフ＆メッセージに加えて町人のセリフやシステムメッセージまでを含む。
blocks.translation: ※The character count includes story dialogue and messages, as well as townspeople's dialogue and system messages.

blocks.source: 各サイトでみつけたセリフ集を頼りに大雑把な文字数を調べたもの。
blocks.translation: I made a rough estimate of the character count based on collections of dialogue found on various websites.

blocks.source: ※ＤＱ１～４、ＦＦ１～４はかな文字のみ。
blocks.translation: ※DQ1–4 and FF1–4 contain kana characters only.

blocks.source: 文章を漢字化すると、２０％程度文字数が減ると考えると良い感じ。
blocks.translation: It is reasonable to assume that converting the text to kanji reduces the character count by about 20%.

blocks.source: ※ＤＱ５はＳＦＣ版の完全なセリフ集が見つからなかったため、文字数は推測値。
blocks.translation: ※The character count for DQ5 is an estimate because I could not find a complete collection of dialogue for the SFC version.

blocks.source: 調査結果についての考察及び補足。
blocks.translation: Analysis and supplementary notes on the results.

blocks.source: ＤＱは町人の会話が豊富。ＦＦはイベントでの会話が豊富だが、町人のセリフは簡素な傾向有り。
blocks.translation: DQ has abundant dialogue from townspeople. FF has abundant event dialogue, but its townspeople's lines tend to be simpler.

blocks.source: ＤＱ６の文章量が予想以上に圧倒的。２つの世界の存在。長めの会話。シナリオ進行によって細かく変化する町人のセリフなどが主な要因か。
blocks.translation: The amount of text in DQ6 is overwhelmingly greater than expected. The existence of two worlds, longer conversations, and townspeople's dialogue that changes in detail as the scenario progresses may be the main factors.

blocks.source: 表には無いがＤＱ７はマリベルのセリフだけで、１３万字程度ある模様。話すシステム恐るべし。全合計で１００万以上かも。
blocks.translation: Although it is not included in the table, DQ7 apparently has around 130,000 characters in Maribel's dialogue alone. The Talk system is truly formidable. The total may exceed one million.

blocks.source: 他にも松野泰己氏のTwitterでの発言によると、ＦＦ１２は６０万とのこと。ちなみに、ＳＦＣ版タクティクスオウガは３０万、ＰＳＰ版タクティクスオウガは７０万だそうです。
blocks.translation: Also, according to a statement by Yasumi Matsuno on Twitter, FF12 has 600,000 characters. For reference, the SFC version of Tactics Ogre has 300,000, while the PSP version apparently has 700,000.

blocks.source: 一般的な小説１冊（文庫）の文字数は１ページあたり５００文字。２００～４００ページと考えて、１０万～２０万字程度。もっとも、ゲームでは小説と比較して冗長な文章は嫌われる。文字数が同程度ならば、小説よりゲームの方が大変かなあと。
blocks.translation: A typical novel (paperback) contains 500 characters per page. Assuming 200–400 pages, that comes to roughly 100,000–200,000 characters. However, excessively verbose writing is disliked in games compared with novels. If the character count is similar, games may be more demanding than novels, I suppose.

blocks.source: 本当は敵数や魔法・特技数、曲数、キャラクター画像数なども調べたかったが、時間の都合で省略。いずれ調べて、追加するかも。
blocks.translation: I wanted to investigate the number of enemies, spells and Techs, songs, character images, and so on as well, but omitted them due to time constraints. I may investigate and add them later.

blocks.source: 次に僕の経験を目安にして、個人制作において、一般的なＲＰＧの作成にかかる作業時間を項目分けしてみた。戻り作業なども多少考慮している。
blocks.translation: Next, using my experience as a guide, I divided the work involved in creating a typical RPG as an individual developer into categories and estimated the time required. I have also taken rework into account to some extent.

blocks.source: あくまで、僕が適当に決めただけなので、自分にそれなりの経験があるならば、そちらを基準に測って頂ければ。
blocks.translation: These are merely figures I came up with arbitrarily, so if you have relevant experience, please use that as your basis for making an estimate.

blocks.source: 町・ダンジョン：１個１５時間
blocks.translation: Towns and dungeons: 15 hours each

blocks.source: ゲームバランス・テストプレイ：１つの町・ダンジョンに付き５時間
blocks.translation: Game balance and playtesting: 5 hours per town or dungeon

blocks.source: 文章・シナリオ：１時間で４００文字
blocks.translation: Writing and scenario: 400 characters per hour

blocks.source: キャラクターグラフィック：１人４時間
blocks.translation: Character graphics: 4 hours per character

blocks.source: モンスターグラフィック：１体５時間（色違いは除く）
blocks.translation: Monster graphics: 5 hours per monster (excluding recolors)

blocks.source: マップチップグラフィック：１種類１０時間
blocks.translation: Tileset graphics: 10 hours per type

blocks.source: 作曲：１曲１０時間
blocks.translation: Music composition: 10 hours per song

blocks.source: 戦闘システム構築：１５０時間
blocks.translation: Battle system development: 150 hours

blocks.source: メニュー画面構築：１００時間
blocks.translation: Menu screen development: 100 hours

blocks.source: ※システム構築時間はどんなものをつくるかによってかなり変化する。あくまで参考値。
blocks.translation: ※The time required to develop systems varies considerably depending on what you create. These figures are for reference only.

blocks.source: ※ＲＰＧツクールなどのツールを使用した場合での目安であるため、自分でプログラムを組む場合は、これの最低２倍は覚悟したほうがよさげ。
blocks.translation: ※These are estimates based on using a tool such as RPG Maker, so if you program everything yourself, you should probably expect it to take at least twice as long.

blocks.source: 上記の表と合わせることで、作りたい作品の規模とそれに必要な時間が何となく割り出せるはず。例えば、ＦＣ版ＤＱ３と同規模のオリジナルＲＰＧをＳＦＣのクオリティで作成したいと考えた場合……。
blocks.translation: By combining these figures with the table above, you should be able to get a rough idea of the scale of the project you want to create and the time it will require. For example, suppose you want to create an original RPG on the same scale as the FC version of DQ3, with SFC-quality graphics and presentation…

blocks.source: （あくまでＳＦＣのクオリティで作成した場合。ＦＣでは色数や音色数が少ないし、マップ構成も単純なため、もっと少なくすむ。）
blocks.translation: (This assumes SFC-quality production. The FC has fewer colors and tones, and its maps are simpler, so it would take less time.)

blocks.source: ○町・ダンジョン：40×15＝600時間
blocks.translation: ○Towns and dungeons: 40×15=600 hours

blocks.source: ○ゲームバランス・テストプレイ：40×5＝200時間
blocks.translation: ○Game balance and playtesting: 40×5=200 hours
○Writing and scenario: 40000÷400=100 hours

blocks.source: ●キャラクターグラフィック：50×4＝200時間
blocks.translation: ●Character graphics: 50×4=200 hours

blocks.source: ●モンスターグラフィック：50×5=250
blocks.translation: ●Monster graphics: 50×5=250 hours

blocks.source: ●マップチップグラフィック：10×10＝100時間
blocks.translation: ●Map graphics: 10×10 = 100 hours

blocks.source: ●作曲：18×10＝180時間
blocks.translation: ●Music composition: 18×10 = 180 hours

blocks.source: ○のみ合計： 900時間
blocks.translation: ○Total for ○ items only: 900 hours

blocks.source: ●含む合計：1630時間
blocks.translation: ●Total including ● items: 1,630 hours

blocks.source: ○の項目は必須だが、●の項目はフリー素材などを利用するならば、考慮しなくてもよい。というか、グラフィックや音楽まで、全て自作する人はまれだと思う。
blocks.translation: The ○ items are essential, but the ● items can be disregarded if you use free resources and the like. In fact, I think it is rare for someone to create everything themselves, including the graphics and music.

blocks.source: また、この時間はオリジナル作品の場合である。著作権の問題はとりあえず無視するとして、仮にＤＱ３のマップをそのままコピーしたり、文章を丸写しするだけならば、恐らく半分程度の時間で完成できる。オリジナル作品を作る場合は構想に時間がかかるし、戻り作業なども発生するので考慮する必要がある。
blocks.translation: Also, these estimates apply to original works. Setting copyright issues aside for the moment, if you simply copied the maps from DQ3 or transcribed all the text, you could probably finish in about half the time. Creating an original work takes time for planning, and you also need to account for reworking things and so on.

blocks.source: リメイクではこうした手間が大幅に軽減される。大手ゲーム会社がリメイク作品ばかりを出したがるのはこういうわけかも。
blocks.translation: Remakes greatly reduce this kind of effort. Perhaps this is why major game companies prefer to release one remake after another.

blocks.source: そして、これにシステム構築する時間を加えれば、大体の制作時間となる。ツールのデフォルトシステムで足りるならば、ほとんど無視できる。
blocks.translation: Adding the time required to build the systems gives you a rough estimate of the total development time. If the tool's default systems are sufficient, this can be almost completely disregarded.

blocks.source: 今回は素材作成も自分でやるとして、1610時間。
blocks.translation: This time, assuming I create the resources myself as well, that comes to 1,610 hours.

blocks.source: 戦闘システムやメニューなども自力で構築するとして、190時間。
blocks.translation: Assuming I also build the battle system, menus, and so on myself, that adds 190 hours.

blocks.source: 合計して、1800時間とみなして話を進める。
blocks.translation: Adding it all together, I will proceed on the assumption that it takes 1,800 hours.

blocks.source: さらに、一日辺りに使用できる平均時間を求める。もちろん、その人の環境によって利用できる時間は変わってくる。部活や習い事、受験勉強、就職活動など、その他の時間を食う活動はしないことが前提だけど、大雑把に見てこんなところかな……？
blocks.translation: Next, let's determine the average amount of time available per day. Of course, the amount of time available varies depending on each person's circumstances. This assumes that you do not have other time-consuming activities such as club activities, lessons, studying for entrance exams, or job hunting, but roughly speaking, perhaps something like this...?

blocks.source: 学生：５～８時間（長期休暇含む）
blocks.translation: Students: 5–8 hours (including extended vacations)

blocks.source: 社会人：２～５時間
blocks.translation: Working adults: 2–5 hours

blocks.source: 無職：８～１２時間
blocks.translation: Unemployed: 8–12 hours

blocks.source: 右側の数字はヒマがあれば、ゲーム制作にいそしむぐらいの勢いでやらないとこうはならない。たとえ、無職で時間が余っていても、１日１２時間もゲーム制作につぎ込むのは至難の技。
blocks.translation: You would only reach the figures on the right if you worked with enough drive to devote yourself to game development whenever you had free time. Even if you are unemployed and have time to spare, putting 12 hours a day into game development is an extremely difficult task.

blocks.source: 社会人は仕事のストレスによって、せっかくの休日なのに制作する気力がない――という悲しい宿命もありえる。
blocks.translation: Working adults may also face the sad fate of having no energy to work on development despite it being their day off, due to stress from their jobs.

blocks.source: ゲーム制作とはかなりの気力を要する作業。疲労などで制作期間に空白を作ってしまった場合は、モチベーションの維持が難しい。職場が休日出勤当たり前だったり、完全週休２日になっていない場合などはこれより厳しくなる。
blocks.translation: Game development is work that requires considerable energy. If fatigue or other factors create gaps in your development schedule, it becomes difficult to maintain your motivation. Things become even more difficult if working on holidays is the norm at your workplace or if you do not have two full days off each week.

blocks.source: １日平均６時間を開発に使える学生ならば、１８００時間必要なＲＰＧを完成させるための期間は３００日となる。
blocks.translation: For a student who can spend an average of six hours a day on development, it would take 300 days to complete an RPG requiring 1,800 hours.

blocks.source: もっとも、これはモチベーションを保てた場合の話。実際は１．５倍～２倍程度を見ておいたほうがよいかも知れない。
blocks.translation: That said, this assumes you are able to maintain your motivation. In reality, it may be better to allow for roughly 1.5 to 2 times as long.

blocks.source: 同じようにパラメータを変えて計算すれば、作りたい作品の規模と自分の環境によって、どれぐらいの期間が必要か目安ながら分かるはず。ぜひ、自分の場合に置き換えて考えてみて頂ければ。
blocks.translation: If you change the parameters and calculate things in the same way, you should be able to get a rough idea of how long you will need, based on the scale of the work you want to create and your own circumstances. I encourage you to consider it by substituting your own situation.

blocks.source: このように市販の大作ＲＰＧと同じような規模の作品を、一人で作りたいなどという場合は年単位の時間が必要となる。ＲＰＧ制作を始めたばかりの初心者がこれだけの長期間、挫けずに制作を続けることは本当に難しい。
blocks.translation: As you can see, creating a work on the same scale as a commercial big-budget RPG by yourself requires years. It is truly difficult for a beginner who has just started making RPGs to continue development without giving up for such a long period.

blocks.source: なので、始めは期間が数週間～数ヶ月に収まる程度の作品から作るほうがおすすめ。フリー素材をうまく活用すれば、数ヶ月程度でもそれなりの作品を作ることも可能なはず。
blocks.translation: Therefore, I recommend starting with a work that can be completed in a few weeks to a few months. If you make good use of free resources, you should be able to create a respectable work in just a few months.

blocks.source: ともあれ、十分な時間さえあれば、数年で市販ＲＰＧと同規模の作品が完成させられるというのも凄い時代になったもの。実際、アマチュアが作成したＲＰＧの中でもＤＱ３以上の規模の作品はさして珍しくない。
blocks.translation: In any case, it is amazing that we live in an era when, given enough time, you can complete a work on the same scale as a commercial RPG in a few years. In fact, among RPGs created by amateurs, works larger than DQ3 are not particularly uncommon.

blocks.source: 作り手に情熱があれば、市販並の美麗３ＤＣＧなどは無理でも、それ以外では市販を超える作品だって、作ることは決して不可能ではないはず。
blocks.translation: If the creator has passion, then even if producing beautiful 3D CG on a commercial level is out of reach, it should certainly be possible to create a work that surpasses commercial releases in other respects.

blocks.source: 最後に、何年という期間で制作を行うと、自分自身や周囲に環境の変化がある可能性は無視できない。
blocks.translation: Finally, when development takes place over a period of several years, you cannot ignore the possibility that circumstances may change for you and those around you.

blocks.source: 一生ゲーム制作をしていたい。ゲーム制作で食っていきたい。ゲーム制作はもはや日課。とかなら大丈夫。しかし、そこまでに至っていないならば、環境の変化によって、意気が挫けたり、気が変わったりして、制作中止となってしまう懸念がある。
blocks.translation: If you want to make games for the rest of your life, earn your living through game development, or have game development as part of your daily routine, you should be fine. However, if you have not reached that point, changes in your circumstances may cause you to lose heart or change your mind, bringing development to a halt.

blocks.source: 自分の環境とゲーム制作への思いを秤にかけて、現実的な期間で完成できる規模に決めよう。
blocks.translation: Weigh your circumstances against your passion for game development, and decide on a scope that you can complete within a realistic timeframe.

For example, suppose you want to create an original RPG on the same scale as the FC version of DQ3, with SFC-quality graphics and presentation…
texts.（あくまでＳＦＣのクオリティで作成した場合。ＦＣでは色数や音色数が少ないし、マッ: (This assumes SFC-quality production. The FC has fewer colors and tones, and its maps are simpler, so it would take less time.)
texts.○の項目は必須だが、●の項目はフリー素材などを利用するならば、考慮しなくてもよい: The ○ items are essential, but the ● items can be disregarded if you use free resources and the like. In fact, I think it is rare for someone to create everything themselves, including the graphics and music.
texts.また、この時間はオリジナル作品の場合である。著作権の問題はとりあえず無視するとし: Also, these estimates apply to original works. Setting copyright issues aside for the moment, if you simply copied the maps from DQ3 or transcribed all the text, you could probably finish in about half the time. Creating an original work takes time for planning, and you also need to account for reworking things and so on.
texts.リメイクではこうした手間が大幅に軽減される。大手ゲーム会社がリメイク作品ばかりを: Remakes greatly reduce this kind of effort. Perhaps this is why major game companies prefer to release one remake after another.
texts.そして、これにシステム構築する時間を加えれば、大体の制作時間となる。ツールのデフ: Adding the time required to build the systems gives you a rough estimate of the total development time. If the tool's default systems are sufficient, this can be almost completely disregarded.
texts.今回は素材作成も自分でやるとして、1610時間。: This time, assuming I create the resources myself as well, that comes to 1,610 hours.
texts.戦闘システムやメニューなども自力で構築するとして、190時間。: Assuming I also build the battle system, menus, and so on myself, that adds 190 hours.
texts.合計して、1800時間とみなして話を進める。: Adding it all together, I will proceed on the assumption that it takes 1,800 hours.
texts.さらに、一日辺りに使用できる平均時間を求める。もちろん、その人の環境によって利用: Next, let's determine the average amount of time available per day. Of course, the amount of time available varies depending on each person's circumstances. This assumes that you do not have other time-consuming activities such as club activities, lessons, studying for entrance exams, or job hunting, but roughly speaking, perhaps something like this...?
texts.右側の数字はヒマがあれば、ゲーム制作にいそしむぐらいの勢いでやらないとこうはなら: You would only reach the figures on the right if you worked with enough drive to devote yourself to game development whenever you had free time. Even if you are unemployed and have time to spare, putting 12 hours a day into game development is an extremely difficult task.
texts.社会人は仕事のストレスによって、せっかくの休日なのに制作する気力がない――という: Working adults may also face the sad fate of having no energy to work on development despite it being their day off, due to stress from their jobs.
texts.ゲーム制作とはかなりの気力を要する作業。疲労などで制作期間に空白を作ってしまった: Game development is work that requires considerable energy. If fatigue or other factors create gaps in your development schedule, it becomes difficult to maintain your motivation. Things become even more difficult if working on holidays is the norm at your workplace or if you do not have two full days off each week.
texts.１日平均６時間を開発に使える学生ならば、１８００時間必要なＲＰＧを完成させるため: For a student who can spend an average of six hours a day on development, it would take 300 days to complete an RPG requiring 1,800 hours.
texts.もっとも、これはモチベーションを保てた場合の話。実際は１．５倍～２倍程度を見てお: That said, this assumes you are able to maintain your motivation. In reality, it may be better to allow for roughly 1.5 to 2 times as long.
texts.同じようにパラメータを変えて計算すれば、作りたい作品の規模と自分の環境によって、: If you change the parameters and calculate things in the same way, you should be able to get a rough idea of how long you will need, based on the scale of the work you want to create and your own circumstances. I encourage you to consider it by substituting your own situation.
texts.このように市販の大作ＲＰＧと同じような規模の作品を、一人で作りたいなどという場合: As you can see, creating a work on the same scale as a commercial big-budget RPG by yourself requires years. It is truly difficult for a beginner who has just started making RPGs to continue development without giving up for such a long period.
texts.なので、始めは期間が数週間～数ヶ月に収まる程度の作品から作るほうがおすすめ。フリ: Therefore, I recommend starting with a work that can be completed in a few weeks to a few months. If you make good use of free resources, you should be able to create a respectable work in just a few months.
texts.ともあれ、十分な時間さえあれば、数年で市販ＲＰＧと同規模の作品が完成させられると: In any case, it is amazing that we live in an era when, given enough time, you can complete a work on the same scale as a commercial RPG in a few years. In fact, among RPGs created by amateurs, works larger than DQ3 are not particularly uncommon.
texts.作り手に情熱があれば、市販並の美麗３ＤＣＧなどは無理でも、それ以外では市販を超え: If the creator has passion, then even if producing beautiful 3D CG on a commercial level is out of reach, it should certainly be possible to create a work that surpasses commercial releases in other respects.
texts.最後に、何年という期間で制作を行うと、自分自身や周囲に環境の変化がある可能性は無: Finally, when development takes place over a period of several years, you cannot ignore the possibility that circumstances may change for you and those around you.
texts.一生ゲーム制作をしていたい。ゲーム制作で食っていきたい。ゲーム制作はもはや日課。: If you want to make games for the rest of your life, earn your living through game development, or have game development as part of your daily routine, you should be fine. However, if you have not reached that point, changes in your circumstances may cause you to lose heart or change your mind, bringing development to a halt.
texts.自分の環境とゲーム制作への思いを秤にかけて、現実的な期間で完成できる規模に決めよ: Weigh your circumstances against your passion for game development, and decide on a scope that you can complete within a realistic timeframe.
